sources.title: Bonsai 27B - Bonsai - docs.prismml.com
sources.snippet: Bonsai 27B is the largest multimodal model in the family: it accepts vision input alongside text. It is based on Qwen3.6 27B. Like every Bonsai, the language model is quantized end-to-end 1-bit or ternary weights across embeddings, attention, MLPs, and the LM head. The vision tower is handled separately, at 4-bit.

sources.snippet: Bonsai 27B Bonsai 27B is PrismML's family of binary and ternary Qwen3.6 27B models, designed to retain strong reasoning, coding, and agentic capabilities at exceptionally small footprints. Highlights 27B reasoning in a phone-class footprint: binary weights compress the language model to about 3.9 GB, bringing 27B-class local inference to high-end phones.
